shared_elements: standing human figure in elaborate costume
low-relief carving on a monolithic stone surface
glyph-like blocks or panels of signs
figures with ornaments at chest/belt (pectoral, loincloth apron)
justification: Both show ceremonial human figures in low relief wearing towering headdresses with scroll/plume elements, adorned with pectorals, belts and hanging apron-like garments, accompanied by blocks of sign-like glyphs framing the scene. The clearest difference is that A presents a multi-figure interaction scene in profile beneath a horizontal text band on a broad slab, while B is a single frontal figure filling a tall vertical field with much denser, more ornate regalia and a frontal face.
